jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Construction
jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a small, tight-knit construction company, specializing in glass & glazing for prevailing wage, public works projects across Southern California. Most of our team has been with us for over five years—we value trust, independence, and teamwork. If you thrive in a professional, stable environment where your work is appreciated and your input is valued, we’d love to meet you.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Project Coordinator with a solid grasp of **public works construction** office operations to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in assisting the project team, overseeing administrative functions, and facilitating communication between various stakeholders. This position requires flexibility and the ability to multi-task easily without micromanagement. There is opportunity for growth.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook); experience with Procore is highly desirable

jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20181749 **Category** Faculty Development

  

Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

  
  

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs

* undefined
* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - Aerospace
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator**

**Latecoere Interconnection Systems**  
**Location**: Los Alamitos, CA  
**Department**: Program Management  
**Reports To**: Program Manager

**Introduction to Latecoere**  
Tier 1 to the world’s leading industry manufacturers, Latecoere serves aerospace with innovative solutions for a sustainable world. The Group operates in all segments of the aerospace industry (commercial, regional, business, defense and space) in two business areas: Aerostructures (doors, fuselage, wings and empennage, struts & rods) and Interconnection Systems (wiring, avionic racks, onboard equipment, electronic systems).

**Position Summary**

Latecoere Interconnection Systems is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Program Coordinator to support the execution of aerospace and defense programs. Reporting directly to the Program Manager, this role is responsible for coordinating program activities, maintaining schedules and documentation, tracking deliverables, and facilitating communication across departments to ensure customer commitments are met on time and within scope.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, enjoys working cross-functionally, and possesses strong project coordination and communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Support the Program Manager in the planning, coordination, and execution of customer programs.

· Maintain program schedules, milestone trackers, action item logs, and status reports.

· Coordinate activities among Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Production, and Finance teams.

· Schedule and facilitate internal meetings, customer reviews, and program status meetings.

· Prepare agendas, presentation materials, meeting minutes, and follow-up actions.

· Compile program metrics and prepare reports for management and customer reviews.

· Communicate delivery performance, schedules, and project status to customers through regular status meetings.

· Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure commitments and deliverables are completed on time.

· Assist in the development and implementation of process improvements that enhance program execution and customer satisfaction.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

· Associate degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

· Two or more years of experience in project coordination, program coordination, customer service, production planning, supply chain, or a related role.

· Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

· Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.

· Knowledge of AS9100 quality standards and aerospace manufacturing processes.

**What You'll Bring**

· A customer-focused mindset.

· Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

· Ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization.

· A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving.

· Ability to work independently while supporting team objectives.

**Physical Requirements**

· Primarily office-based with regular interaction on the manufacturing floor.

· Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for extended periods.

· Ability to occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

**Compensation**

· $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

(Actual compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, education, skills, and business needs.)

Join a global aerospace leader and play an integral role in supporting programs that help connect and power the world's leading aircraft platforms. At Latecoere, you'll work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Social Media Outreach Coordinator for Nonprofit Foundation
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE FOUNDATION**

The foundation is a nonprofit focused on expanding educational and professional opportunities for students pursuing careers in medicine and healthcare, particularly those from historically underrepresented and underserved communities. Its programs include **mentoring, medical pathway programming, academic enrichment, medical student support, and community health outreach.**

The organization’s activities provide a broad range of content for social media, including **student success stories, medical education, mentorship opportunities, academic programming, health education, social events, and opportunities for students and volunteers.**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Social Media Coordinator will help **tell the foundation's story and increase its visibility and engagement** through social media. The Coordinator will primarily manage **Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube**, creating engaging content that highlights the organization’s programs, people, accomplishments, and community impact.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage the organization’s **Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube** accounts.
* Develop a monthly content calendar and maintain a consistent posting schedule.
* Create and publish **posts, reels, short videos, graphics, stories, captions, and content**.
* Highlight programs, student activities, mentoring, MCAT preparation, community outreach, health fairs, and other organizational initiatives.
* Capture and share appropriate **photos, videos, testimonials, student achievements, mentor/physician highlights, and event content**.
* Promote applications, events, workshops, volunteer opportunities, and other activities.
* Monitor engagement and provide periodic updates on social media performance.
* Maintain appropriate **professionalism, accuracy, branding, privacy, and permissions**.
* Collaborate with leadership, students, physicians, mentors, volunteers, and community partners.
* Attend in-person academic, community, and social events to capture photos/videos for online content. Event schedule to be provided.
* Work with team to develop foundation approved social media content.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Strong communication, creativity, organization, and initiative.
* Experience with social media content creation and management.
* Familiarity with **Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube**.
* Canva, photography, videography, or video-editing experience preferred.
* Interest in **medicine, education, mentorship, health equity, or community engagement** preferred.

**TIME COMMITMENT**

Minimum **12-20 hours per week** with a flexible schedule. Occasional weekend availability may be required for events and content creation.

**CORE PURPOSE**

To tell the organization’s story, showcase its people and impact, and use social media to connect students, physicians, mentors, volunteers, partners, donors, and the community with its mission.

Pay: $21.50 - $23.00 per hour

Expected hours: 12.0 – 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90068

jobs.title: Government Affairs & Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION: is to eliminate health disparities and foster community well-being by providing and promoting the highest quality care in Los Angeles, San Bernardino, and Riverside Counties.

OUR VISION: St. John’s Community Health will be a leader, catalyst, and model for the best care, long-term community health improvements, and sustainable, health-enhancing system and structures in Southern California.

OUR CORE VALUES

Dignity

We honor and respect every person we encounter—whether patient, colleague, or community member—as a valued part of the human family.

Excellence

We support and champion the best standard of care, personal and professional growth, accountability, creativity, teamwork, and a steadfast commitment to quality.

Well-being

We promote and advocate for the full integration of our patients’ physical and mental health in order to enable them to participate in their own health improvement and become active and responsible members of a vibrant and just community.

Social Justice

We collaborate with others to develop systems, organizations, and programs to advance equity and fairness in allocating community resources, and to empower and address the needs of all community members, especially the most vulnerable and disadvantaged members.

JOB SUMMARY

The Government Affairs & Communications Coordinator supports St. John’s Community Health’s government affairs, advocacy, community engagement, and communications work. This position helps turn St. John’s policy and advocacy priorities into clear messages, materials, and public communications. The role also supports elected official engagement, policy research, advocacy campaigns, civic engagement, media work, and special projects. The person in this role should be a strong writer, organized, comfortable working with elected officials and community partners, and able to manage several projects at the same time. The position requires someone who can take initiative while also following St. John’s processes, messaging, approvals, and expectations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Performs a combination, but not necessarily all, of the following duties:

Government Affairs and Policy

* Track local, county, state, and federal policy issues that may affect St. John’s, its patients, and community health centers.
* Research legislation, government actions, funding opportunities, and policy proposals.
* Prepare briefing memos, talking points, background materials, public comments, and meeting materials for the Chief Government Affairs & Community Relations Officer and other St. John’s leaders.
* Support meetings with elected officials, government agencies, and key stakeholders.
* Help track follow-up items, commitments, deadlines, and next steps from government meetings.
* Support advocacy campaigns related to health care access, the safety net, health equity, and the right to health care.

Communications

* Help develop clear messages that explain St. John’s policy, advocacy, and community work.
* Draft newsletters, talking points, stakeholder updates, event materials, social media content, press materials, and other communications.
* Support media outreach, press events, interviews, and public statements.
* Help translate complicated policy issues into language that patients, community members, elected officials, and the public can understand.
* Support communications for major advocacy campaigns, public events, and organizational priorities.

Advocacy and Civic Engagement

* Support patient and community organizing, civic engagement, voter education, advocacy events, and community meetings.
* Help develop materials for advocacy trainings, Right to Health committees, and other civic-engagement efforts.
* Support efforts that move patients and community members from participation into deeper advocacy and leadership.
* Assist with voter education and nonpartisan civic-engagement activities consistent with St. John’s nonprofit status.

Community and Stakeholder Engagement

* Support relationships with community organizations, elected officials, government staff, coalitions, and other partners.
* Help coordinate meetings, events, roundtables, briefings, and community activities.
* Prepare background materials and follow-up communications for external partners.
* Support coalition participation and partnership-building tied to St. John’s policy and community priorities.

Project Coordination

* Manage assigned government affairs and communications projects from start to finish.
* Maintain timelines, work plans, contact lists, briefing materials, and follow-up items.
* Coordinate with departments across St. John’s to collect information and complete materials.
* Support special projects assigned by the Chief Government Affairs & Community Relations Officer.
* Help make sure materials are accurate, approved, and completed on time.

Responsibility to Team – actively support assigned team/department by participating in and supporting all team/departmental initiatives, proactively communicating with supervision, meeting assigned goals and objectives, and committing to embracing process improvement initiatives.

Responsibility to Organization – actively support SJCH by consistently meeting St. John’s Mission, Vision, and Values; modeling positive interactions with patients, staff, and community; keeping informed of internal (e.g., policies and procedures) and external (e.g., legal or political matters) which may affect business.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Introduction:

At Sprouts Farmers Market, the Administrative Coordinator is responsible for in-store accounting procedures, cash and funds, timekeeping, and payroll transmissions. The Administrative Coordinator keeps store files up to date and maintains an efficient stock of office supplies. They also partner with Human Resources and Store Management on hiring, onboarding, team building, and conflict resolution.

Overview of Responsibilities:

* Consistently demonstrate a positive attitude, organizational skills, high level of accuracy, attention to detail, time management skills, and willingness to learn new products.
* Take direction, communicate, and collaborate effectively with others.
* Collect, verify, and distribute tills and change drawers.
* Total all checks, cash, credit cards, and create reports from the previous day.
* Oversee the balancing of the safe and create refund reports.
* Prepare bank deposits and record all data for cash, checks, food stamps, WIC instruments, and charge vendor coupons.
* Help maintain front end security to control cash, shrink, and dishonesty.
* Facilitate hiring, onboarding, and training of new employees.
* Process internal transfers and job/pay changes.
* Support a positive and engaging work environment while adhering to all safety, health, and compliance regulations.
* Help plan and execute team building and recognition events.
* Pull and distribute sales reports for each department.
* Stay up to date on company procedures, policies, and benefits to keep store employees informed.
* Keep store files organized and up to date.
* Order office supplies to maintain an efficient stock level.
* Ensure timekeeping and payroll functions are completed correctly and on time.
* Maintain a clean, sanitized, and organized office and work areas.
* Demonstrate product knowledge and provide prompt, friendly service to help customers make their selections.
* Remain informed of sales and ad items to assist customers in a prompt and friendly manner.
* Adhere to all safety, health, and compliance regulations.
* Flexible to perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Must be at least 18 years of age.

jobs.title: Sales & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:

We’re looking for a motivated, organized, and resourceful Sales & Events Coordinator to join our team at Califia Farms. This fast-paced, hands-on role supports sales operations, event execution, and trade marketing activations while coordinating branded merchandise, POS materials, and sales collateral.

From national trade shows to local café activations, no two days look the same. The ideal candidate is a proactive go-getter who enjoys wearing multiple hats, takes initiative, and can turn conversations and ideas into action. We’re looking for someone who is detail-oriented, adaptable, and ready to roll up their sleeves to get things done.

This hybrid role works in the DTLA Arts District office Tuesday through Thursday.

Responsibilities:

* Coordinate logistics for regional and national events, including trade shows, barista engagement events, selling shows, and café pop-ups. Support planning, product shipments, vendor coordination, booth setup, and on-site execution.
* Maintain event calendars, project trackers, workback schedules, and budgets to keep projects organized and on track.

Required Skills & Abilities

* Adaptable and versatile, comfortable wearing multiple hats in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Resourceful problem solver who can anticipate needs, navigate challenges, and find solutions.
* Strong communicator and team player who collaborates effectively with internal teams and external partners.

* Proficient in Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, and project management tools.
* Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms preferred.
* Experience with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator is a plus, for basic design edits, resizing files and preparing print or digital materials.
* Experience with Canva, Shopify, or inventory management platforms is a plus.
* Event coordination, vendor management, or budget tracking experience preferred.
* Willingness to provide hands-on support during event setup, execution, and breakdown.
* Based in Los Angeles with approximately 15–20% travel required, including occasional evenings and weekends.

The expected salary range for this position is between $70,500.00 - $75,000.00 per year based on a full-time schedule. You may also be eligible to participate in the company’s bonus program which may be subject to change.

The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, disability, age, religion or any other classification protected by law.

jobs.title: Events and Operations Specialist - School Of Medicine
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

  
The Events and Operations Specialist at the Kaiser Permanente Bernard J. Tyson School of Medicine (KPSOM) is responsible for independently managing key programs, events and operational initiatives within the Offices of Student Affairs (OSA) and Student Engagement. They plan, coordinate, manage, and serve as the primary staff contact for Signature Student Events from initial planning through execution and post event follow up, with responsibilities including budget tracking, vendor management, purchasing, expense reconciliation, and logistical implementation. They manage assigned Student Affairs projects and initiatives in partnership with the Senior Director of Student Affairs including project planning, stakeholder coordination, information management, communications and implementation tracking. The specialist will serve as the operational lead for the student professional development funding program, managing the end-to-end administrative process, such as eligibility review, approval workflows, documentation tracking, student communications and process improvement.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Independently manages logistical planning for Student Affairs events, including venue and space requests, vendor management, purchasing support, registration, and day-of execution support.

jobs.title: Manager, Event Operations - Dunkman
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Authentic Brands Group (Authentic) is a global brand and entertainment platform that owns and invests in iconic intellectual property and cultural assets. It accelerates brands through a set of specialized businesses that combine powerful storytelling, premium content, unforgettable live experiences and global commerce. Through a network of more than 1,700 best-in-class licensees and strategic partners across 150 countries and expansive distribution, Authentic's brands drive more than $38 billion in annual systemwide retail sales worldwide.

Authentic's diversified portfolio spans more than 50 brands and reaches nearly one billion social media followers. Its roster includes Reebok, Champion, Shaquille O'Neal, David Beckham, Kevin Hart, Sports Illustrated, Elvis Presley, Muhammad Ali, Marilyn Monroe, GUESS, Aéropostale, Nautica, Eddie Bauer, Lucky Brand, Nine West, Brooks Brothers, Juicy Couture, Vince Camuto, Izod, Van Heusen, Dockers, Ted Baker, Hart Schaffner Marx, Vince, Barneys New York, Judith Leiber, Quiksilver, Spyder, Billabong, Volcom, Roxy, RVCA, DC Shoes, Prince, Sperry and Hunter.

For more information, visit corporate.authentic.com. Follow Authentic on LinkedIn, Instagram and WeChat.

**Why Authentic**

You'll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we're saying is, this isn't your average day job. If you're hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let's chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.

**What You'll Do**

TheManager, Operations will play a key role in planning and executing Dunkman, Shaquille O'Neals professional dunk league and entertainment platform. Dunkman will be this role's primary focus, with responsibility for coordinating event operations, production logistics, and business processes across its programming on a global scale. Sitting on the Authentic Live team and reporting to the VP, Operations the ideal candidate brings hands-on live event experience, strong project management skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple partners in a fast-paced environment. The role may also support the wider Authentic Live portfolio as project needs and capacity allow.

  

**What You'll Be Working On**

*Dunkman Event Production and Execution*

* Support planning and execution across Dunkman competitions, exhibitions, and related activations, from pre-production through on-site delivery and post-event closeout.
* Coordinate with production agencies, venues, broadcast partners, and internal teams on operational requirements, production schedules, rehearsals, load-in, event delivery, and load-out.
* Maintain project plans, workback schedules, operational run-of-show documents, and action trackers; lead status meetings and follow up on deadlines and dependencies.

*Business Operations*

* Maintain event budgets and expense trackers, flag changes, and support post-event financial reconciliation.

**Must Haves**

* 3–5 years of experience in live event production or event operations within sports, entertainment, or media.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams and external partners.
* Sound judgment and the ability to remain composed, solve problems, and meet tight deadlines during live events.

**Primary Location Salary Range:** $80,000 - $100,000

**Fraud Alert: Unauthorized Job Offers and Impersonations**

We have been made aware of fraudulent job offers and interview requests being sent by individuals falsely claiming to represent Authentic. These scams are often initiated via email, employment websites and social media, and may include fake interview requests, offer letters or attempts to collect personal and financial information.

Please note:

* All legitimate Authentic job postings can be found only on our official website (authentic.com) or through our verified LinkedIn page (https://www.linkedin.com/company/weareauthentic).

As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

The National Account Manager, Market Access Employer Engagement, is a strategic, external-facing member of US Market Access. Reporting to the Director, Employer Engagement - Obesity, this role leads engagement with a defined portfolio of jumbo employers and the organizations that shape their health-benefit decisions, including employer benefit consultants, coalitions, TPAs, PBMs, carriers, point-solution partners and, where relevant, IDNs. This role combines consultative account leadership with deep market access expertise. The Account Manager develops account strategies, uncovers customer needs and market barriers, coordinates compliant Amgen resources, and translates field insight into enterprise strategy, evidence generation, tools and launch readiness. Own a strategic regional portfolio of priority jumbo employers and employer ecosystem accounts; create and execute account plans that define customer objectives, stakeholder maps, access barriers, value exchange, actions, measures and escalation needs.

Build trusted, senior-level relationships with employer benefits, total rewards, pharmacy, medical, finance and procurement leaders, as well as EBCs, consultants, coalition leaders, TPAs, PBMs, carriers and appropriate point-solution partners.

Lead consultative discussions on obesity benefit design, access and affordability, utilization-management approaches, patient journey and population-health outcomes, within approved Amgen strategy and compliant engagement models.

Identify and advance appropriate access opportunities through the employer decision ecosystem; coordinate with internal market access strategy, contracting, brand, medical, HEOR/RWE, value communications, patient support and field teams.

Translate Amgen clinical, economic and real-world evidence into customer-relevant value discussions; identify evidence gaps and bring actionable needs to HEOR/RWE and strategy partners.

Develop scalable employer-facing capabilities, including account tools, meeting-in-a-box content, market insights and solution concepts that support launch readiness and sustained engagement.

Monitor and communicate employer benefit, PBM, vendor, policy and competitive trends. Deliver concise, decision-ready insights that inform segmentation, account prioritization, contracting, evidence generation and brand strategy.

Represent Amgen at employer, consultant and coalition meetings and selected industry forums; expand the organization’s external presence and credibility in the employer market.

Maintain rigorous account documentation, CRM hygiene, performance tracking and compliance with all legal, regulatory, privacy and company requirements.

Conduct field sales support as necessary to drive pull through of coverage opportunities and resolve billing and coding issues related to Amgen products

* Demonstrated ability to influence access, coverage, benefit design, affordability or population-health decisions in a complex healthcare ecosystem.

**Overview of Role**

The Account Manager serves as a primary commercial and operational interface between TSMC North America and its advanced-node and 3DIC customers, managing the business relationship across quotation and pricing, demand forecasting and fulfillment, new tape-out management, and technology-roadmap engagement. Based within the North America Account Management organization and reporting to the Account Management Director, this role coordinates closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan and with internal operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) teams to ensure seamless execution and customer satisfaction. It is a hands-on role at the outset that grows into broader account ownership and new-business enablement, offering a seasoned semiconductor professional the opportunity to shape how TSMC supports its most advanced technology customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the end-to-end business relationship for assigned accounts, leading pricing and quotation discussions and ensuring there is no disconnect between the customer and TSMC.
* Own demand forecasting and fulfillment, aligning internal forecast and program execution across operations and planning to close the loop and complete the business.
* Drive new tape-out management — planning, execution, and operational coordination with headquarters customer service for new product introductions on advanced nodes.
* Promote TSMC's technology roadmap to customers and coordinate internal resources across operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) to meet and exceed customer requirements.
* Resolve production and supply issues across the factory, headquarters, and customer, and grow into account strategy and new-business enablement over time.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist III, AWS Account Management and Governance
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking an Applied Scientist III to own the technical vision and development of an AI-based governance intelligence platform that will redefine how account and organizational governance is defined, validated, and enforced at scale. This mission-critical platform will leverage AI-driven autonomous agents to conduct proactive, intelligent governance operations across the account lifecycle.  
The platform will integrate deeply with organizational management, identity, and cloud-native control systems to provide self-serve, automated governance insights, policy verification, and enforcement mechanisms. The Governance Foundations team is building a unified governance foundation that consolidates account management controls — including automated enrollment, managed policies, and account lifecycle guardrails — into a single, intelligent, scalable system.  
As a senior science leader on the team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy on ambiguous, open-ended problems that span multiple organizations. You will set the multi-year scientific direction, make the architectural and modeling decisions that others build on, and drive alignment across applied science, engineering, product, and partner teams — up to and including senior leadership. This is an opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven governance assurance at enterprise scale: defining standards, influencing company-wide account governance posture, and leading technical innovation at the highest level.  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Own and define the next-generation governance intelligence and policy-matching platform, setting the multi-year technical strategy for AI-driven governance automation across applied science and engineering teams and resolving the hardest, most ambiguous problems in the space.
* Build on and advance a multi-agent LLM framework for autonomous governance operations, and influence partner organizations to adopt the most promising approaches — including human-in-the-loop enforcement boundaries that cannot be bypassed by autonomous agents.
* Develop a highly scalable intelligent governance agent framework — combining traditional ML and LLM-based techniques — that enables internal teams to automate validation, classification, and enforcement across structured and unstructured policy and account data.
* Provide technical leadership and scientific mentorship across the broader organization — raising the bar on science quality, growing other scientists and engineers, and representing the team's technical direction to senior leadership — while still diving deep hands-on to diagnose complex system performance and correctness problems in distributed governance control planes.
* Define the scientific metrics, evaluation methodology, and quality bar by which the platform's governance decisions are measured and trusted.

  
About the team

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (SF/LA/NYC)
jobs.description:
**About Gantri**

Gantri is the product innovation foundry for the design industry. We built the simplest way for designers, brands, and creators to launch category-defining products for their audiences at a fraction of traditional costs. We manufacture products on-demand at our Digital Factory in California from Gantri PlantPolymers, high-performance bio-polymers that replace traditional oil based plastics and eliminate the need for inventory.

Since launching lighting in 2017, we have introduced over 200 products by some of the world's best designers, earning more awards than any other design manufacturer in America, including Fast Company's Most Innovative in Design and TIME's Best Inventions. In 2026 we launched Gantri Wireless, the biggest leap forward in lighting in decades: full-powered light anywhere you go.

**The role**

You will run Gantri's digital marketing engine across every channel: paid social, paid search, email, SMS, affiliate, and on-site conversion. You own the numbers. The single most important output of this role is a cross-channel reporting system built on multi-touch attribution that tells us, with confidence, where each dollar of DTC revenue comes from and where the next dollar should go.

This is a role for a builder of systems, not a firefighter. We are looking for someone who creates order: clean data, documented processes, reliable weekly reporting, and campaign calendars that are planned months ahead rather than days. You will be the person in the room who can say what actually happened, why, and what we should do next, with the model to back it up.

You will manage our two agency relationships (paid media and email) directly and be accountable for their output.

This role reports to our Head of Brand.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build and own cross-channel performance reporting using multi-touch attribution. This includes designing the attribution model, maintaining the data pipeline behind it, reconciling platform-reported and modeled numbers, and producing the weekly and monthly views the leadership team runs the business on.
* Plan, budget, and forecast DTC marketing spend across channels. Set targets for CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution margin, and new-customer revenue, then track performance against them.
* Own the day-to-day relationship with our paid media agency: briefs, budgets, creative requests, testing roadmaps, and performance reviews. Hold them to targets.
* Own the relationship with our email and SMS agency: campaign calendar, flows, segmentation strategy, list growth, and deliverability. Hold them to targets.
* Run the campaign calendar across all channels, coordinated with product launches, designer collaborations, promotions, and seasonal moments.
* Partner with the creative team to brief and evaluate ad and email creative. You will not design it, but you need to recognize what is on-brand and what is working, and translate performance data into creative direction.
* Run structured testing programs (audiences, creative, offers, landing pages) with clear hypotheses, sample sizes, and readouts.
* Monitor on-site funnel metrics (conversion rate, AOV, checkout drop-off) and work with the ecommerce and product teams on fixes.
* Maintain clean tracking: pixels, UTMs, server-side events, and the integrity of data flowing into the attribution model and analytics stack.

### **Required Experience**

* 5+ years in digital marketing or growth for a DTC brand, with a proven record of growing DTC revenue. You should be able to walk us through the numbers: what you inherited, what you changed, what happened.
* Experience in a design-led brand in home, lifestyle, beauty, fashion, or an adjacent category. You understand how considered-purchase, aesthetics-driven products are sold online.
* Exceptional quantitative skills. You are comfortable building and maintaining attribution models, cohort analyses, LTV/CAC models, and spend forecasts in spreadsheets or BI tools. You understand the limitations of platform-reported attribution and how to triangulate with incrementality testing, MMM, or post-purchase surveys.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of the ecommerce stack: Klaviyo or equivalent, Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, and at least one attribution or analytics platform (Northbeam, Triple Whale, Rockerbox, or similar).
* Highly organized. You run on calendars, trackers, documented processes, and written briefs, and you keep multiple agencies and workstreams moving on schedule without being chased.
* Experience managing external agencies and holding them accountable to performance targets.
* A good eye for brand. You can tell when creative is off-brand and articulate why, and you respect that aesthetics are part of the product. You do not need to be a designer.
* Clear, concise written communication. Your reports and recommendations should be readable by someone who was not in the meeting.

### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with SQL or a BI tool (Looker, Metabase, Mode) for pulling and modeling data directly.
* Exposure to B2B or trade marketing alongside DTC.
* Experience at a company with on-demand or made-to-order fulfillment, where inventory constraints differ from traditional ecommerce.

### **Why Gantri?**

* Be part of a company reimagining how design meets manufacturing.
* Play a pivotal role in shaping the building blocks of Gantri products.
* Drive innovation on our next-generation digital manufacturing platform.
* Advance sustainable design practices in real-world production.
* Work in a fast-growing, design-driven environment.
* Bring visionary concepts to life at scale.

### **Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity options
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid time off and flexible vacation policy
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Professional development opportunities and learning stipend
* Collaborative, creative, and sustainability-focused work environment
* Access to Gantri-designed products and innovation in

You'll be the bridge between our sales and design team and the shop floor. Reporting to our GM Operations and working closely with our Production Lead, you'll keep sold jobs on track from handoff to delivery — checking in materials, running QC on finished work, and keeping inventory and purchasing records accurate. Just as important, you'll be the day-to-day link to our Mandarin-speaking production staff, making sure job details, changes, and quality issues are clearly understood on both sides. This position serves as a Suicide Prevention Coordinator (SPC) for James J. Peters (JJP) Bronx VA Medical Center. The SPC is organizationally co-aligned with Mental Health Service and Social Work Service but provides Suicide Prevention services for the JJP VAMC catchment area. The incumbent manages the daily operation of the Suicide Prevention Program (SPP), provides care coordination and case management services, administers crisis interventions, promotes system and community-wide crisis resources, provides suicide prevention education and training, and collects/records mandatory data for National, Veteran Integrated Service Network (VISN) and local reporting services. The SPC is a member of the Suicide Prevention Team (SPT) and collaboratively works with the SPT members in the development of policies and procedures for program operations, implementation of suicide prevention strategies with an emphasis on ensuring that all appropriate measures are taken to prevent suicide.Primary duties of this position include:

* The coordination and monitoring of mental health and medical services for Veterans identified as "high risk" for suicide, collaboration with the Veteran's Mental Health Treatment Coordinator (MHTC) and clinical treatment team to provide suicide prevention consultation, track treatment progress, and provide individualized, comprehensive case management services.
* S/he collaborates with treating clinicians to assess risk and provide guidance about criteria for Patient Record Flags Category I - High Risk for Suicide (HRS-PRF) placements and ensures that high-risk Veterans are receiving appropriate care following their HRS-PRF placements, including increased frequency of clinical care visits and follow-up after missed appointments.
* In conjunction with the healthcare team, the incumbent identifies and assesses risk, safety, supports and implements appropriate interventions/treatment for those who are experiencing abuse, neglect, exploitation or are experiencing domestic or intimate partner violence. Adheres to VA and mandated reporter requirements. Advises and collaborates with interdisciplinary teams throughout the medical center on abuse, neglect, exploitation, and intimate partner violence issues.
* The incumbent is responsible for responding to referrals from staff members, the Veterans Crisis Line (VCL), and other touch points to ensure that at-risk Veterans immediately receive care and services.
* The SPC performs mandated outreach and awareness activities as a member of the SPT to increase awareness of suicide prevention best practices and to improve the public's understanding and knowledge of suicide risk factors, military culture, lethal means safety and the accessibility of available resources, such as the Veterans Crisis Line (VCL).
* The incumbent engages in educational activities including, but not limited to, dissemination of clinical practice guidelines, educational materials related to suicide prevention, training both clinical and nonclinical staff within VA to identify and respond to Veterans who are at increased risk for suicide and providing training to community organizations and staff who have contact with Veterans (e.g. local SPP procedures, suicide prevention topics such as crisis response, safety planning, postvention, suicide risk screening and evaluation).

jobs.description:
**Who we are**

  

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on.

### **About this Role**

Semafor is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented **Contract Audience Coordinator** to support the Audience Development team during a busy period of global events.

This is a hands-on execution role supporting audience acquisition, event communications, RSVP management, and operational coordination. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and able to execute quickly and accurately in a fast-paced environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Audience Acquisition & RSVP Management**

* Execute personalized, one-to-one email invitations to prospective event attendees.

**Event Communications & Content**

**Event Operations & Administrative Support**

* Maintain accurate audience data and assist with database management and data entry.
* Support the preparation of attendee lists, check-in materials, and event-day documentation.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure attendee information is accurate and up to date.
* Provide general administrative and operational support across multiple events.

### **Ideal Experience & Skills**

* Previous experience in event coordination, audience development, marketing operations, or administrative support.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong written communication skills and professional email etiquette.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, databases, and event management systems.
* Ability to manage repetitive, detail-intensive tasks with speed and accuracy.
* A proactive, adaptable approach and willingness to support wherever needed.

*This position is ideally based out of either our New York, NY or Washington, D.C. offices, but we are open to remote candidates outside either region.*

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Authentic Brands Group (Authentic) is a global brand and entertainment platform that owns and invests in iconic intellectual property and cultural assets. It accelerates brands through a set of specialized businesses that combine powerful storytelling, premium content, unforgettable live experiences and global commerce. Through a network of more than 1,700 best-in-class licensees and strategic partners across 150 countries and expansive distribution, Authentic's brands drive more than $38 billion in annual systemwide retail sales worldwide.

Authentic's diversified portfolio spans more than 50 brands and reaches nearly one billion social media followers. Its roster includes Reebok, Champion, Shaquille O'Neal, David Beckham, Kevin Hart, Sports Illustrated, Elvis Presley, Muhammad Ali, Marilyn Monroe, GUESS, Aéropostale, Nautica, Eddie Bauer, Lucky Brand, Nine West, Brooks Brothers, Juicy Couture, Vince Camuto, Izod, Van Heusen, Dockers, Ted Baker, Hart Schaffner Marx, Vince, Barneys New York, Judith Leiber, Quiksilver, Spyder, Billabong, Volcom, Roxy, RVCA, DC Shoes, Prince, Sperry and Hunter.

For more information, visit corporate.authentic.com. Follow Authentic on LinkedIn, Instagram and WeChat.

**Why Authentic**

You'll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we're saying is, this isn't your average day job. If you're hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let's chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.

**What You'll Do**

TheManager, Operations will play a key role in planning and executing Dunkman, Shaquille O'Neals professional dunk league and entertainment platform. Dunkman will be this role's primary focus, with responsibility for coordinating event operations, production logistics, and business processes across its programming on a global scale. Sitting on the Authentic Live team and reporting to the VP, Operations the ideal candidate brings hands-on live event experience, strong project management skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple partners in a fast-paced environment. The role may also support the wider Authentic Live portfolio as project needs and capacity allow.

  

**What You'll Be Working On**

*Dunkman Event Production and Execution*

* Support planning and execution across Dunkman competitions, exhibitions, and related activations, from pre-production through on-site delivery and post-event closeout.
* Coordinate with production agencies, venues, broadcast partners, and internal teams on operational requirements, production schedules, rehearsals, load-in, event delivery, and load-out.
* Maintain project plans, workback schedules, operational run-of-show documents, and action trackers; lead status meetings and follow up on deadlines and dependencies.
* Support credentialing, access plans, staffing, ticket allocations, and guest logistics in coordination with venue, ticketing, hospitality, and security teams.
* Broadcast Coordination: Coordinate with broadcast partners on programming plans, asset delivery, editorial feedback, production requirements, and broadcast standards.
* Serve as an on-site operational contact, resolve issues within assigned responsibilities, and escalate decisions or risks to leadership.

  

*Business Operations*

* Maintain event budgets and expense trackers, flag changes, and support post-event financial reconciliation.
* Coordinate with Finance and Legal on vendor onboarding, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and incoming and outgoing payment tracking.
* Document post-event learnings and refine planning templates and standard operating procedures for future Dunkman programming.
* Support planning and execution of other Authentic Live events as assigned, based on Dunkman priorities, scheduling, and available capacity.

  

**Must Haves**

* 3–5 years of experience in live event production or event operations within sports, entertainment, or media.
* Experience coordinating venue logistics, production timelines, vendors, and event budgets; sports competition or broadcast event experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams and external partners.
* Sound judgment and the ability to remain composed, solve problems, and meet tight deadlines during live events.
* Willingness to travel and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends as required (up to 40%).

  

**Primary Location Salary Range:** $80,000 - $100,000

**Fraud Alert: Unauthorized Job Offers and Impersonations**

We have been made aware of fraudulent job offers and interview requests being sent by individuals falsely claiming to represent Authentic. These scams are often initiated via email, employment websites and social media, and may include fake interview requests, offer letters or attempts to collect personal and financial information.

Please note:

* All legitimate Authentic job postings can be found only on our official website (authentic.com) or through our verified LinkedIn page (https://www.linkedin.com/company/weareauthentic).
* Authentic does not conduct interviews over Teams or Zoom

jobs.title: Development Coordinator
Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Location: Secaucus, NJ

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Marketing Manager

Dotted-Line Coordination: Creative Director of Marketing, Brand Editor, and Social Media Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt), overtime-eligible

Compensation: $26–$31 per hour

Artistic Tile is looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support our Marketing Department while building real event and design skills along the way. This is a high-growth role: reporting to the Marketing Manager, you'll get exposure to every part of the department — email, website, product literature, social, PR, and events — and the chance to take on more as you show what you can do.

Your core work is events, followed by design. You'll help plan and run the showroom events and trade shows that put our brand in front of customers and dealers, and you'll use tools like Canva and AI-assisted design to produce the collateral, labels, and presentations that support our sales and marketing efforts.

About Artistic Tile

Artistic Tile is a family-owned and operated luxury tile and stone company—design, import, distribution, and retail under one roof. We're leaders in our field because of the value we place on design innovation, quality control, and customer service. You'll join a marketing team known for producing content that sets the standard for the industry. Our reputation is established; your job is to help create the work and the experiences that uphold it.

What You'll Do

* Event Concept & Production: Help plan and execute showroom events and trade shows, coordinating the invitations, signage, and on-site branding (working with the Creative Director and design team on the look) along with venue selection, catering, rentals, and vendor coordination, for both in-person and virtual events.
* On-Site Event Presence: Represent the brand in person at events, making real-time calls on setup, signage placement, and presentation so the space matches the approved brand look and event plan.
* Design & Collateral Production: Using Canva and AI-assisted design tools, design swatch cards, recess tray labels, product literature layouts, internal presentation templates, social graphics, and other brand collateral — owning each piece from first draft through final, print-ready file. You'll work within the brand templates and standards set by the Creative Director of Marketing, and extend them to new needs.
* AI-Assisted Workflow & Accuracy: Use AI tools to speed up layout, reformatting, and first drafts, and review all output for brand fit and for accuracy against product data (SKUs, dimensions, finish names, ratings) before anything is routed for approval or printed.
* Marketing Department Support: Support the full marketing team day to day, helping the Marketing Manager and teammates across email, website, product literature, social, and PR projects; organizing and distributing promotional materials to showrooms, dealers, and partners; and keeping project tasks and timelines current in Basecamp.
* Brand Stewardship: Work with external vendors and agencies to keep design and messaging consistent and high-quality across every channel.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, product development, and design to keep marketing materials aligned, accurate, and on-brand.

What We're Looking For

* At least 1 year of related experience in event coordination, marketing, or design.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, design, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Experience or strong interest in event logistics and vendor coordination — venues, catering, rentals — and in the on-site energy of a live event.
* Strong time and project management skills, with a knack for prioritizing and hitting deadlines, especially under the pressure of a live event date.
* Fluency in Canva, including building and maintaining templates and brand kits.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude) in design or content work, and the judgment to review their output critically.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can tailor a message clearly for different audiences.
* Comfort working autonomously: you can self-direct your daily tasks and take ownership of a project from concept to completion.
* A collaborative spirit and openness to feedback.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to travel occasionally and work some evenings/weekends around event dates (all hours worked are paid, with overtime per company policy and applicable law).

Bonus Points

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).
* Experience with NetSuite, CRM software, or Basecamp.
* Basic familiarity with email marketing platforms or website content management.

Why You'll Want This Role

* Events with visible impact: You'll help create the showroom events and trade show experiences that customers, designers, and dealers remember — and see how the brand shows up in person.
* Modern tools: We're building our design workflow around Canva and AI-assisted tools, so you'll grow skills that are in demand.
* A high-growth role: This is a launchpad. Demonstrate your skills and there's a clear path to take on greater creative and strategic responsibility as the department grows.
* Exposure to the whole department: Working under the Marketing Manager, you'll see how email, web, print, PR, and events fit together — a fast way to learn the business and find where you want to specialize.
* A great location: A modern headquarters in Secaucus with an easy commute from Manhattan and throughout North New Jersey.

Pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

**Why PermitFlow Wants You**
----------------------------

This role is foundational. We are standing up a dedicated Account Management function so that every signed enterprise customer has one clear commercial owner. You'll own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of the largest builders, contractors, developers, and multi-brand home-services platforms in the country — protecting renewals, closing expansion, and turning signed agreements into compounding partnerships. Every one of those accounts gets a single, named commercial owner for the life of the relationship. That's you.

You carry a quota and own the number: renewals, upsell, cross-sell, new-product and business-unit expansion. Implementation owns onboarding and go-live, Ops owns the day-to-day operating cadence, and Customer Success owns account health and adoption. You own everything commercial from the moment an account clears its opt-out window, and you convert delivered value into retained and expanded revenue.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the commercial relationship and a $6M+ enterprise book of business from the moment each account becomes a PermitFlow customer.
* Lead every renewal end to end — strategy, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal, close
* Build and close expansion pipeline across products, business units, geographies, brands, and volume tiers
* Develop multi-year account plans, stakeholder maps, whitespace maps, and mutual commercial plans
* Build trusted relationships from decision makers at both the regional an national level, including the C-suite and private-equity sponsors
* Translate operational outcomes — time-to-permit, throughput, cost, and risk reduction — into executive-grade ROI narratives
* Own renewal and expansion forecasting, CRM hygiene, next steps, and close plans
* Partner tightly with Implementation, Ops, and Customer Success on onboarding, operating cadence, health, adoption, and risk signals while holding a clean commercial swim-lane
* Help build the Account Management playbook — handoffs, tiering, cadences, forecasting, account-planning standards
* ~20% Travel as needed for customer meetings, executive reviews, industry events (e.g. Pantheon), and portfolio-company HQ visits

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Enterprise Commercial Leader:** 8+ years in enterprise Account Management, expansion sales, or a comparable quota-carrying post-sale role
* **Self Starter:** You’ve seen this show before and can help build the foundation of what this will look like as we continue to scale
* **Proven Revenue Owner:** You have personally managed a $5M+ book and can show GRR, NRR, renewal, and expansion numbers
* **Complex Deal Operator:** Comfortable with $200K+ ACV accounts, multi-threaded negotiations, procurement, security and legal reviews, and multi-entity rollouts
* **Seller, Not Just a Steward:** You source, qualify, price, negotiate, and close expansion yourself — you don't hand it to Sales
* **Executive Relationship Builder:** You're just as credible sitting across from a CFO as you are talking with a branch manager at a job site - warm, direct, curious, and plainspoken no matter who's in the room
* **Strategic and Analytical:** You connect usage and outcomes to financial impact, risk, pricing, and a multi-year growth thesis
* **Forecast-Disciplined:** Clear stages, close plans, renewal timelines, accurate commits
* **Cross-Functional Partner:** You create clarity and momentum across Sales, CS, Product, Solutions, Support, Legal, Finance, and RevOps
* **Industry Knowledge:** Construction-tech, PropTech, field-service software, home services, or another operationally complex vertical strongly preferred

**How Success Will Be Measured**
--------------------------------

* Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
* Expansion ARR closed, and expansion pipeline coverage, win rate, and velocity
* Renewal rate and renewal/expansion forecast accuracy
* Account, brand, geography, and product penetration
* Quality of executive relationships, account plans, and cross-functional execution
* Contribution to a repeatable Account Management operating model

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary, uncapped commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth company
* 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA
* 401(k) savings plan
* Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
* Home office & equipment stipend
* Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided
* Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

*PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Account Management | Community InstitutionsOverview  
Mastercard's Community Institutions team is launching Team Catalyst, an innovative new account management model designed to redefine how we partner with our longer-tail customers.  
  
As customer expectations evolve and operational complexity increases, we are transforming from a traditional one-to-one account management structure to a collaborative, team-based model that enables us to deliver deeper expertise, greater consistency, and broader access to Mastercard's capabilities.  
  
Team Catalyst is an incubation team focused on building the future of customer partnership and engagement.
  
  
We are challenging conventional approaches, creating scalable strategies, leveraging data and automation, and finding new ways to bring the full power of Mastercard to our customers.  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to help design, build, and scale a new model while directly influencing customer growth, experience, and operational excellence across a portfolio of Community Institution customers.  
  
If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy turning ideas into action, and are energized by solving complex problems, we'd love to meet you.  
  
The Role  
As a Manager, Account Management on Team Catalyst, you will help shape and execute the future vision for customer engagement within Mastercard's Community Institutions segment.  
  
You will combine strategic thinking, customer relationship management, business development, and operational excellence to drive measurable outcomes for both customers and Mastercard.  
  
Working within a highly collaborative team environment, you will identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive execution, and continuously refine our approach to customer growth.

* Innovate: Help evolve Mastercard's next-generation account management model for Community Institutions, identifying new ways to scale customer engagement, drive operational efficiency, and enhance the customer experience.

* Advise: Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders by understanding their business objectives, strategic priorities, operating challenges, and market opportunities.
* Champion: Lead strategic initiatives from concept through execution, partnering across Mastercard to design solutions, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes for customers and the business.
* Collaborate: Partner closely with teams across Product, Services, Technology, Operations, Marketing, and Sales to bring the full breadth of Mastercard capabilities to customers and accelerate adoption of solutions that deliver meaningful business value.
* Negotiate: Own the end-to-end deal lifecycle for customer renewals and growth opportunities, including RFP responses, deal modeling, contract negotiations, and stakeholder alignment.
* Engage: Design and execute scalable customer engagement strategies through 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs, including webinars, office hours, customer education forums, thought leadership campaigns, and portfolio-wide communications.

  
All About You  

* Builder who enjoys creating new playbooks, processes, and ways of working.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by solving complex problems.
* Strategic thinker with a proven track record of execution.
* Exceptional relationship builder and trusted advisor.
* Skilled at influencing and collaborating across cross-functional teams.
* Growth-oriented with a track record of identifying opportunities and delivering business results.
* Commercially minded with strong negotiation, sales, and deal management capabilities.
* Effective communicator with experience engaging executive stakeholders.
* Positive, team-first mindset with a love for collaboration and a willingness to roll up your sleeves to make things happen.
* Self-starter who is highly organized, curious, and results-oriented.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

As a **Platform Technical Account Manager** at Integral Ad Science, you own the post-sales technical relationship for key clients. Your primary objectives are to drive efficiency and business value by helping clients fully leverage IAS's solutions, analyze customer workflows, identify opportunities for process improvement, and serve as a trusted advisor on best practices in digital media and ad tech environments.

**Note:** The responsibilities below reflect the core of this role today, but this is a fluid position, priorities, ownership areas, and day-to-day focus will shift as client needs and internal processes evolve. We're looking for someone comfortable operating in grey areas, without a fully defined playbook, and who can adapt accordingly.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Advocacy & Service SLA Management:**  
  Serve as the main technical point of contact for key clients, delivering guidance on adopting and optimizing IAS' product offerings. Monitor and manage partner-specific technical support operations for IAS products and integrations to contractually defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and response/resolution metrics. Review and interpret client contracts to understand defined SLAs, obligations, and risk areas, and apply that understanding to prioritize work, escalate appropriately, and guide client-facing decisions.
* **Workflow Automation:**  
  Audit internal processes to identify areas for automation, recommending and implementing AI-driven solutions to streamline day-to-day work.
* **Proactive Support:**  
  Monitor client health and key metrics with insights; flag anomalies, preempt issues, and ensure clients are positioned for success.
* **Enablement & Training:**  
  Deliver training sessions and supporting materials to upskill client teams on new AI-driven features and integrations.
* **Continuous Improvement & Feedback Loop:**  
  Gather and relay client feedback to Product and Engineering, advocating for new automation capabilities and smarter workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**  
  Partner closely with internal stakeholders across Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Operations to support account growth, align on feature roadmaps, and resolve complex technical escalations seamlessly. Be able to work in non-defined roles and responsibilities to deliver results.
* **Client Travel:**  
  Occasional travel to client sites may be required to build relationships, deliver trainings, or conduct strategic technical reviews.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a TAM, platform support, or technical client success role (preferably in ad tech or SaaS).
