jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Some careers are just jobs. This one is different. At **Georgia HOPE**, the work you do every day creates meaningful change for children, families, and individuals who need it most.

We're a Georgia-based behavioral health provider on a mission to instill hope, empower lives, and strengthen communities. Our team specializes in supporting individuals facing emotional and behavioral challenges—often those who have experienced trauma, instability, or significant life stressors. We deliver services directly in the homes, schools, and communities where our clients live and grow, because real progress happens when care is personalized, strengths-focused, and meets people where they are.

As part of the **Health Connect America** family—a COA-accredited organization serving children, families, and adults across nine states—you'll have the resources, support, and professional development of a larger organization, paired with the close-knit, mission-focused culture that defines our work.

**If you’re looking for a career where your impact is visible, your growth is supported, and your work truly matters, you’ll find it here.**

**Health Connect America Family of Brands**

**If you're someone who thrives in a role that blends direct client impact with operational support and team coordination, this role was built for you.**

As a Program Coordinator at Georgia HOPE, you’ll provide hands-on services to clients while supporting the day-to-day operations that keep programs running effectively and efficiently.

**What You’ll Do**

As a Program Coordinator, you’ll balance direct service delivery with operational and administrative support. Your work will focus on client care, coordination, and ensuring program effectiveness. Day to day, you can expect to:

* Provide direct care services to assigned clients while maintaining accurate, timely documentation in compliance with company, state, and payer requirements
* Support day-to-day program operations, including coordination of admissions, authorizations, billing, payroll, and internal processes
* Communicate regularly with clients, families, referral sources, and staff to ensure effective service delivery and coordination
* Assist with staff support functions including training coordination, mentoring, and participation in hiring and onboarding activities
* Contribute to program performance through involvement in budgeting, financial review, marketing efforts, and regional development initiatives
* Support compliance and quality efforts by participating in audits, reviewing documentation, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and accreditation standards

**What to Expect**

This is a hybrid role that combines direct client interaction with operational and administrative responsibilities. You’ll work closely with the Program Director and broader team to ensure services are delivered effectively while supporting the infrastructure behind the program. Success in this role requires strong organization, adaptability, and the ability to shift between client-facing work and behind-the-scenes coordination. You’ll play a key role in maintaining program quality, supporting team performance, and ensuring clients receive timely, well-coordinated care.

**We welcome candidates who bring a genuine commitment to children and families and meet the following qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in human services discipline, including, but not limited to Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Counseling, Criminal Justice, etc.
* At least two (2) years of experience working with children and/or families (experience can include internships, volunteer work, etc.).
* Experience in leadership and management is preferred.

**Be Well with Us**

We know that people who take care of others need to be taken care of too. That's why Health Connect America offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self — professionally and personally:

* Flexible scheduling and a culture that recognizes the importance of work/life balance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) including 8 mental health counseling sessions annually — because your well-being matters
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Medical, dental, vision, and voluntary insurance options
* Health Savings Account with company contribution
* Dependent Daycare Flexible Spending Account
* Access to a Health Navigator
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Benefits Hub and Tickets at Work — exclusive savings and perks for everyday life

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

Join a team where your contributions truly matter. Apply now to be part of our community at Georgia HOPE, part of Health Connect America.

*Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background investigation.*

jobs.title: Home Care Scheduling & Operations Coordinator Administrative Support.
jobs.description:
**Administrative & Operations Support Coordinator**
===================================================

**Gaddiel Homecare Services, Inc.**  
**Location:** Peachtree Corners, Georgia  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Reports To:** Administrative Operations Manager

Compensation: $40,000–$46,000 annually, commensurate with qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

**About Gaddiel Homecare Services**
-----------------------------------

Established in 2014, Gaddiel Homecare Services, Inc. is a growing home care agency dedicated to helping seniors and adults maintain their independence, dignity, and quality of life in the comfort of their homes.

We provide personal care, companionship, respite care, skilled nursing services, and specialized support through Medicaid waiver programs, including CCSP/SOURCE, NOW/COMP, and ICWP.

Our mission is **“Bringing peace of mind, one family at a time.”**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive **Administrative & Operations Support Coordinator** to support our daily home care operations.

This is a hands-on position that plays a critical role in coordinating caregiver schedules, maintaining continuity of care, communicating with clients and caregivers, and ensuring that operational tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate is someone who anticipates problems, takes initiative, communicates effectively, and follows through without constant supervision.

This position requires strong attention to detail, excellent time management, and the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Caregiver Scheduling and Staffing Coordination**

* Coordinate and maintain daily and weekly caregiver schedules using WellSky Personal Care.
* Monitor scheduled visits to ensure clients receive services as planned.
* Respond promptly to caregiver call-outs, cancellations, and scheduling changes.
* Identify qualified replacement caregivers and coordinate coverage.
* Match caregivers to client needs based on qualifications, availability, location, and compatibility.
* Communicate scheduling changes to caregivers, clients, and authorized family members.
* Monitor upcoming schedules to anticipate staffing gaps before they affect service delivery.
* Escalate unresolved staffing challenges to the Administrative Operations Manager.

### **Client Services and Communication**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for routine scheduling and service-related inquiries.
* Maintain professional and compassionate communication with clients, families, and caregivers.
* Coordinate new client service starts following completion of required assessments and approvals.
* Follow up with clients regarding caregiver assignments, service changes, and scheduling concerns.
* Document client communications and service-related issues accurately.
* Escalate clinical concerns to the nursing team and significant operational concerns to management.
* Help maintain strong client relationships through timely communication and reliable follow-through.

### **Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) and Documentation**

* Monitor caregiver clock-ins, clock-outs, and visit documentation in WellSky.
* Identify missed visits, incomplete documentation, and EVV discrepancies.
* Follow up with caregivers to obtain accurate information and supporting documentation.
* Prepare EVV exception reports for management review.
* Assist with reconciling scheduled, completed, and documented service hours.
* Ensure documentation is completed within established agency timelines.
* Support accurate payroll and billing preparation by identifying and reporting discrepancies.

### **Operational and Administrative Support**

* Assist with client onboarding and coordination of service initiation.
* Maintain accurate schedules, operational logs, and service coordination records.
* Monitor pending tasks, deadlines, and follow-up requirements.
* Collaborate with the Administrative Assistant on documentation and recordkeeping.
* Work closely with the Recruiter to communicate staffing shortages and anticipated caregiver needs.
* Assist the Administrative Operations Manager with implementation of operational procedures.
* Prepare daily staffing updates and operational reports.

### **Quality Assurance and Compliance**

* Follow agency policies, confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Help ensure caregivers are assigned only to services for which they are qualified and cleared.
* Identify potential service delivery or documentation concerns and report them promptly.
* Assist with administrative preparation for audits and quality assurance reviews.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives to strengthen scheduling accuracy, communication, and service reliability.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Previous experience in home care scheduling, healthcare coordination, staffing, or a related administrative role.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and resolve scheduling challenges under pressure.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
* Proficiency with computers, Microsoft Office, and electronic scheduling systems.
* Ability to handle confidential client and employee information professionally.
* Strong customer service skills and a commitment to reliable service delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* At least two years of experience in home care scheduling or healthcare operations.
* Experience using WellSky Personal Care or a similar home care management platform.
* Familiarity with Electronic Visit Verification (EVV).
* Knowledge of Georgia home care services and Medicaid waiver programs

**Job Description**

The ISV Manager for Sage Intacct is a key commercial role responsible for driving revenue, accelerating partner performance, and expanding adoption of Intacct ISV solutions across North America.
  
  
This role serves as the connective tissue between ISV partners, internal sales teams, VARs, and cross-functional stakeholders. The ISV Manager ensures sellers have clear, accurate, and actionable information—pricing, value propositions, promotions, and sales plays—to operate with speed and confidence.
  
  
The ISV Manager also leads partner-facing commercial initiatives, including campaigns, promotions, and enablement programs, designed to generate pipeline and improve sales execution across regions.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly organized, commercially minded, and thrives in a fast-paced, sales-facing environment while building strong relationships across the Intacct ISV ecosystem.
  
  
\*This is a hybrid role - 3 days onsite\*

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Commercial & Revenue Enablement
  
- Drive sales performance across Intacct price-list ISVs by supporting pipeline creation, monitoring partner activity, and helping regions identify high-value commercial opportunities.
  
- Partner with regional sales leadership to surface trends, whitespace, and growth opportunities across ISVs and customer segments.
  
- Support quota-carrying teams with timely insights that help advance and close ISV-influenced opportunities.
  
  
Sales Enablement & Partner Readiness
  
- Equip sales, VARs, and cross-functional teams with accurate ISV information, pricing guidance, value propositions, and enablement materials that strengthen customer conversations.
  
- Lead the development and maintenance of ISV battlecards, sales plays, and reference materials.
  
- Respond quickly to ad-hoc sales requests, including partner details, pricing checks, commercial insights, and opportunity validation.
  
  
Partner & Program Management
  
- Maintain comprehensive Intacct ISV partner lists and records, ensuring real-time visibility into offerings, promotions, product updates, and go-to-market changes.
  
- Track ISV performance against goals, highlighting trends, risks, and opportunities across partners and regions.
  
- Support partner-facing initiatives such as promotions, campaigns, and limited-time offers in coordination with Marketing and Sales Ops.
  
  
Data, Systems & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
- Ensure data accuracy and consistency in Salesforce to support clean forecasting, reporting, and pipeline visibility.
  
- Collaborate closely with Sales Operations, Finance, Product, and Marketing on KPIs, pricing, commercial positioning, and go-to-market execution.
  
- Identify and recommend improvements to ISV sales processes, tools, and enablement materials to improve seller efficiency and speed to close.
  
  
Skills & Experience:
  
- 3+ years of experience in sales, partner management, channel programs, or sales operations—ideally within accounting software, ERP, or ISV ecosystems.
  
- Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or influencing quota-carrying sales teams.
  
- Proven ability to translate complex product and partner information into clear, compelling sales messaging.
  
- High proficiency in Salesforce, Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
  
- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities across regions and stakeholders.
  
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
- Experience working with ISVs, VARs, or partner ecosystems strongly preferred.
  
  
What Success Looks Like in This Role
  
- Sales teams have clear, current, and trusted ISV information at their fingertips.
  
- ISV pipeline visibility and forecasting accuracy improve.
  
- Partner promotions and sales plays are executed consistently across regions.
  
- Sellers move faster and more confidently when positioning Intacct ISVs with customers.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brayden, Founder at Sola, and I'll be leading the hiring for this role.

Sola owns every layer of insurance, from pricing with weather data to paying claims, and thousands of independent agents now trust us to protect their clients' homes. Almost all of those agencies found us through word of mouth, and as we grow beyond wind and hail into broader home coverage, the agencies that already sell Sola are the heart of our business. We're looking for an Account Manager who will treat a book of those agencies as their own, help them win more with Sola every month, and show our newer teammates what great partnership looks like.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR**
---------

* **Role:** Account Manager
* **Level:** Mid-level individual contributor, one step above Associate Account Manager
* **Key focus:** Owning and growing a book of independent agency partners
* **Location:** West Midtown, Atlanta, GA

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Account Manager to own a book of active independent agency partners and grow what they write with Sola. The job is to become the person each of your agencies calls first, keep Sola part of their everyday sales conversations, and turn quiet agencies into consistent producers.

You are someone who has already owned a set of accounts or partners on your own, who measures your work by retention and growth, and who enjoys being both a trusted advisor and a problem solver. This is not a traditional service desk role where you wait for tickets, and it is not a hunting role focused on signing new agencies, since our Territory Sales Managers bring partners in and you help them thrive.

You should constantly be:

* Checking in with your agencies by phone, video and in person so they feel confident quoting Sola
* Spotting which agencies are slowing down and acting before they go quiet
* Training agents on our product, tools and process so selling Sola feels easy
* Solving escalations quickly with our underwriting, claims and product teams
* Bringing what you hear from agencies back to the team so we keep improving

You'll work closely with the rest of Account Management, our Territory Sales Managers and our product team, and you'll help build the playbook that the next wave of Associate Account Managers learns from.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* A defined book of active independent agencies and their retention with Sola
* Growth in quotes and policies written across your book
* A regular cadence of check-ins, reviews and agency visits
* Agent training on Sola's product, quoting tools and process
* Fast, complete resolution of agency escalations across teams
* Clean CRM records and a clear view of the health of every account
* Agency feedback shared with product and leadership
* Day-to-day coaching for Associate Account Managers who shadow your work

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

### **Must-haves**

* Experience owning a book of accounts or partners yourself in account management, customer success or a partner-facing role, typically two to four years
* Real results in retaining and growing accounts that you can walk us through with numbers
* A steady, self-driven cadence for check-ins, follow-ups and escalations
* Strong CRM habits and the instinct to use data to decide where to spend your time
* Clear, warm communication with business owners on the phone, in writing and in person
* Curiosity, coachability and low ego, with a habit of asking why
* Based in Atlanta or open to relocating, and someone who enjoys building alongside the team in person. We work together from our West Midtown office five days a week because we've found that our best ideas, fastest problem solving and closest working relationships come from being in the same room.

### **Strong plus**

* Experience working with independent insurance agents, brokers or another reseller channel
* Time at an early-stage startup where you helped build the process
* Experience training customers or coaching junior teammates
* Comfort using dashboards, simple analysis or AI tools to manage a book

### **Not a fit**

* You prefer a support role where someone else owns the relationship and the growth goal
* You want a pure new business hunting role
* You need a fully built playbook before you can perform
* You are looking for a remote or hybrid schedule

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Stock options, so you share in what you help build
* 100% paid medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family
* Unlimited PTO
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office
* Regular team dinners, happy hours and other evenings out, because we genuinely enjoy spending time together beyond the workday

**Our Values**
--------------

* **We are a team of owners.** Every role at Sola has a direct and measurable impact on the success of the company.
* **The best idea always wins.** We leave egos at the door, no matter the title.
* **Always raise the bar.** Our goal: improve at least 1% every day.
* **Customer and partner driven.** Our north star is delivering the best experience to the people we serve.
* **Results focused.** We're a hands-on, results-oriented team with a bias for action.
* **Ask why, stay curious.** Curiosity drives progress. We question the status quo and learn every day.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Sola Technologies Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Production Artist & Print Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Production Artist & Print Project Coordinator

Riverside Graphics and Lowitz + Sons are established Chicago printing companies providing digital printing, commercial printing, design, and print production management services. We handle everything from everyday business printing to more complex publications, marketing materials, and specialty print projects.

We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented person with practical layout, typesetting, and prepress skills to support our customer service and production teams.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on position combining basic layout and typesetting, preflight and file preparation, order processing, and print project coordination.

Initially, the role will primarily support our existing customer service representatives and project managers behind the scenes, helping prepare files, process orders, develop estimates, and coordinate production. As you become familiar with our customers and processes, the goal is to take on greater responsibility for managing projects and providing direct customer support.

We're looking for someone who understands how printing works, enjoys solving problems, and is comfortable handling a variety of responsibilities in a small business environment.

Responsibilities

**Graphics & Prepress**

* Prepare, review, and modify customer artwork for print production.
* Create and revise layouts for brochures, booklets, business cards, presentations, and other printed materials.
* Preflight files, identify potential printing issues, and make necessary corrections.
* Prepare print-ready PDFs, proofs, and production files for digital and commercial printing.
* Work with our production team and outside vendors to ensure files are prepared correctly.

**Order Processing & Project Coordination**

* Assist customer service representatives and project managers with preparing estimates, writing orders, and coordinating jobs.
* Review project specifications and identify missing information or potential production issues.
* Request pricing and coordinate production details with outside printing and finishing vendors.
* Track job progress, follow up on outstanding items, and help keep projects moving through production.
* Support both Riverside Graphics' in-house printing operations and Lowitz + Sons' commercial print projects.
* Develop the ability to communicate directly with customers and fully manage assigned projects.

**Production Support**

* When needed, assist the production team with basic hand assembly, finishing, packaging, and shipping.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat.
* Experience preparing artwork and files for commercial printing.
* Working knowledge of bleeds, trim sizes, resolution, color modes, and other print production requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities.
* Comfortable working independently, recognizing problems, and asking questions when needed.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to work collaboratively with customer service, production staff, and outside vendors.

**Preferred, but not required:**

* Previous experience working for a commercial printer, quick-print shop, or print production company.
* Experience with print estimating, job tickets, or print management software.
* Familiarity with digital printing equipment and basic bindery operations.
* Experience communicating with customers or coordinating print projects.

**What We're Looking For**

The right candidate is someone who combines practical design and technical production skills with good organization and follow-through.

We value accuracy, reliability, flexibility, and a willingness to learn. You should enjoy working on a variety of projects and be comfortable in an environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

This is a good opportunity for someone with graphic design or prepress experience who wants to expand into print production coordination and project management.

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

As one of the fastest-growing on-the-go drinkware companies in America, we’ve got a reputation for doing great things. Our vision is simple - bring delight to eating and drinking.

Delight is different to everyone. Whether it’s the perfect cup of coffee, or a water bottle that helps you crush your workout, our mission is to make it look great, function perfectly and cost less than you’d expect.

Delivering on this promise takes extraordinary efforts and exceptional people. Through our teams’ ingenuity and grit, we’ve created a place where the best ideas win, and they can come from anyone. Our culture combines the scrappy spirit of a startup with the perks of a market leader.

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as commuter benefits and additional voluntary benefits
* Annual bonus payouts for all salaried employees, and up to a 5% 401k match with no vesting period

**What you can expect:**

The Clinical Research Coordinator position is responsible for supporting clinical research staff and managing new and ongoing clinical research activities. The position includes assisting clinical investigators and research staff to drive projects forward by interacting closely with external clinical research organizations and sponsors.

Preparation of all study documentation such as protocols, amendments, case report forms, SAE reports, and study reports is an integral part of this job. The Clinical Research Coordinator will adhere to GCP, ICH, and FDA guidelines in the conduct of all study-related activities.

* Create and update paper and electronic study patient records
* Participate in other recruitment/retention activities as needed, including calling potential participants and occasional outreach
* Attend trainings, staff meetings, and in-services as required

* Strong attention to detail, ability to take initiative
* Possess the ability to prioritize while multi-tasking in a team setting or alone
* Working knowledge of general medical terminology
* Working knowledge industry regulations, standards and guidance

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager (B2B Sales)
jobs.description:
**Build a Career Helping Local Businesses**

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring full-time **Account Managers** to join our **Schaumburg** team, serving businesses throughout the local area.

In this role, you’ll work directly with business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. You’ll primarily manage existing customer relationships while continuing to grow your portfolio through new business development.

Unlike many sales positions where every month starts at zero, you’ll build a book of business that can continue generating recurring income through customer renewals and long-term relationships, all while helping business owners reduce their overall energy costs.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**

Many sales jobs focus only on closing the next deal. Here, you’ll build lasting relationships with local business owners while creating a customer portfolio that can continue producing income through future renewals and residual commissions.

Many of our **Account Managers** have been with us for 10+ years because they’ve built a "businesses within the business" — creating recurring income from customer relationships they’ve nurtured over time.

We also believe the best leaders are developed from within. As we continue expanding into more than 20+ markets over the next few years, we’re creating new leadership opportunities for Account Managers who want to grow with us long term.

**What You’ll Do**

Your day begins at the office, where you’ll connect with your team, prepare for the day ahead, and follow up with existing customer accounts before heading into your assigned territory. From there, you’ll determine the best way to optimize your day as you crush your goals. Typical responsibilities included:

* Build lasting relationships with existing commercial customers.

* Support customers through future renewals and ongoing energy needs.
* Prospect for new clients by meeting face-to-face with local business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Develop new business opportunities between customer appointments.
* Build and grow your own portfolio of commercial accounts.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

Successful Account Managers come from a variety of backgrounds, but they all enjoy working with people, building relationships, and helping customers find solutions. If you’re someone with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and the drive to continually improve, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**You bring the work ethic. We’ll provide the training.**

**Compensation**

**Performance-Based Earnings + Residual Income**

* Commission earned on new accounts
* Residual commissions on existing accounts you continue to manage
* Increased earning potential as you build and grow your client portfolio

**Typical first-year on-target earnings (OTE) range from $65,000–$90,000, with top performers earning $125,000+ by consistently exceeding performance goals and growing their book of business.**

* *Additional compensation structures may be available for qualified applicants.*

**Paid Training & Career Development**

Your previous experience gives you a foundation—we’ll help you build on it. You’ll receive **paid, hands-on training** focused on our industry, products, client management process, and approach to growing a book of business.

As you progress, you’ll have access to continued **coaching, mentorship, and professional development** designed to strengthen your skills and prepare you for future opportunities in leadership and business management. Our long-term growth depends on developing talented people who are ready to take on more.

**About Universal Energy Solutions**

Universal Energy Solutions helps businesses reduce their energy costs by connecting them with competitive electricity and natural gas supplier programs. **UES Careers** is the recruiting arm of Universal Energy Solutions, supporting hiring across our growing nationwide network of independently owned and operated offices.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of related sales experience
* Valid driver’s license
* Reliable personal vehicle
* Authorized to work in the United States
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable meeting with business owners face-to-face

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing role
* Self-motivated with strong communication and organizational skills
* Prior knowledge and experience in the deregulated energy field

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Multiple compensation paths designed to support your career goals
* Paid training
* Commission paid weekly
* Additional performance-based incentives and bonuses

**Career Development**

* Hands-on training from experienced mentors
* Ongoing career coaching
* Advancement opportunities into Management positions

**Additional Benefits**

* Health benefits after eligibility requirements are met
* Team-oriented work environment

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Position summary**
--------------------

The National Account Manager, Market Access Employer Engagement, is a strategic, external-facing member of US Market Access. Reporting to the Director, Employer Engagement - Obesity, this role leads engagement with a defined portfolio of jumbo employers and the organizations that shape their health-benefit decisions, including employer benefit consultants, coalitions, TPAs, PBMs, carriers, point-solution partners and, where relevant, IDNs. This role combines consultative account leadership with deep market access expertise. The Account Manager develops account strategies, uncovers customer needs and market barriers, coordinates compliant Amgen resources, and translates field insight into enterprise strategy, evidence generation, tools and launch readiness. Success is measured by the quality and strategic depth of customer engagement, access progress within priority accounts, actionable insight and cross-functional impact - not by traditional sales call activity alone.

**Key responsibilities**

Own a strategic regional portfolio of priority jumbo employers and employer ecosystem accounts; create and execute account plans that define customer objectives, stakeholder maps, access barriers, value exchange, actions, measures and escalation needs.

Build trusted, senior-level relationships with employer benefits, total rewards, pharmacy, medical, finance and procurement leaders, as well as EBCs, consultants, coalition leaders, TPAs, PBMs, carriers and appropriate point-solution partners.

Lead consultative discussions on obesity benefit design, access and affordability, utilization-management approaches, patient journey and population-health outcomes, within approved Amgen strategy and compliant engagement models.

Identify and advance appropriate access opportunities through the employer decision ecosystem; coordinate with internal market access strategy, contracting, brand, medical, HEOR/RWE, value communications, patient support and field teams.

Translate Amgen clinical, economic and real-world evidence into customer-relevant value discussions; identify evidence gaps and bring actionable needs to HEOR/RWE and strategy partners.

Develop scalable employer-facing capabilities, including account tools, meeting-in-a-box content, market insights and solution concepts that support launch readiness and sustained engagement.

* Doctorate degree and 2 years of sales, marketing, market access, employer benefits or payer experience; OR Master’s degree and 4 years; OR Bachelor’s degree and 6 years; OR Associate’s degree and 10 years; OR High school diploma or GED and 12 years of relevant experience.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to influence access, coverage, benefit design, affordability or population-health decisions in a complex healthcare ecosystem.

Executive Assistant to the Dean, School of Education (4702C) #89532 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley, we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging make it a special place for students, faculty, and staff. As a world-leading institution, Berkeley is known for its academic and research excellence, public mission, diverse student body, and commitment to equity and social justice. Since our founding in 1868, we have driven innovation, creating global intellectual, economic, and social value. We are looking for applicants who reflect California's diversity and want to be part of an inclusive, equity-focused community that views education as a matter of social justice. Please consider whether your values align with our Guiding Values and Principles , Principles of Community , and Strategic Plan .
  
  
At UC Berkeley, we believe that learning is a fundamental part of working, and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups (staff organizations). Our goal is for everyone on the Berkeley campus to feel supported and equipped to realize their full potential. We actively support this by providing all of our full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours (10 days) of paid time per year to engage in professional development activities. Find out more about how you can grow your career at UC Berkeley.
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Berkeley School of Education is a professional school that offers doctoral degrees with 4 concentrations, master's degrees, master's/credential programs, and an undergraduate degree.
  
  
The school enrolls slightly under 300 graduates and about 300 undergraduates annually. Including visitors, the staffing headcount totals about 500. In addition to research, the school is highly visible in its international, national, state-wide, and local outreach, professional development, and enrichment programs.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Executive Assistant serves as the principal point of contact between the Graduate School of Education (GSE) Dean and faculty, staff, students, and other constituencies. This position provides comprehensive, confidential, and professional support to the Dean, including coordinating communications and administrative processes within the executive office and among senior management staff.
  
  
The Executive Assistant performs and oversees special projects or assignments that are sensitive or complex in nature, requiring a high level of independence and initiative. This position performs a variety of analytical duties in support of the Dean, prepares daily briefings, and assists the Dean and/or Associate Dean in drafting and modifying documents. Additionally, this position manages internal and external correspondence, contributes to administrative operations, including school-wide reviews and graduate student financial data, and serves as the safety officer and back-up building coordinator.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. Applications will remain open for consideration until the position is filled.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Using discretion and diplomacy, responds to routine & non-routine inquiries regarding department and campus operations, policies, and procedures. Forwards situations and issues presented by staff, faculty, and external constituents to appropriate staff members for resolution. Makes high-level contacts of a sensitive nature internally and externally, requiring a high degree of discretion, diplomacy, and time sensitivity.
  
Understands the program goals and priorities of the executive, in order to prioritize issues according to urgency and to allocate the executive's time for scheduled events and meetings
  
Provides administrative and technical assistance on special projects as assigned by the Dean and Assistant Dean; researches, gathers data, compiles and summarizes issues, policies, and topics; reaches out internally and externally to obtain background, briefing, and meeting materials; assists in preparing, editing, and modifying documents including research reports, manuscripts, presentations, and proposals; prepares, edits, and modifies briefings.
  
Participates in the development and implementation of efficient and effective systems for managing information, projects, and communication to ensure accurate and timely responses; functions as a gatekeeper to assure prioritization of the Dean's time.
  
Responds to a wide variety of inquiries from faculty, staff, and students. Uses multiple computer applications to support key administrative functions. Manages the Dean's task list and follow-up activities to ensure timely project completion. Has primary responsibility for managing and scheduling the Dean's calendar. Prioritizes the Dean's time by triaging critical situations as they arise. Collects and prepares information for use in discussions and meetings. Ensures accurate and frequent communication among the Dean, Associate Dean, and Assistant Deans to support project management. Records minutes or notes of meetings as required. Handles the details of a variety of matters on behalf of the Dean. Drafts briefing documents for the Dean, as well as correspondence and other general communications. Develops and manages a database of contacts, initiatives, and assignments; assists with copying, mailing, and filing.
  
Collect, organize, and maintain data for short- and long-range planning initiatives.
  
On behalf of the Dean, plans and directs complex events, symposia, receptions, and forum programs. Establishes location, negotiates contracts for catering, set-up, equipment, transportation, and other logistics.
  
Serves as backup Building Coordinator.

**TSMC North America**

**Account Manager/Technical Manager (7987)**

**Overview of Role**

The Account Manager serves as a primary commercial and operational interface between TSMC North America and its advanced-node and 3DIC customers, managing the business relationship across quotation and pricing, demand forecasting and fulfillment, new tape-out management, and technology-roadmap engagement. Based within the North America Account Management organization and reporting to the Account Management Director, this role coordinates closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan and with internal operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) teams to ensure seamless execution and customer satisfaction. * Own demand forecasting and fulfillment, aligning internal forecast and program execution across operations and planning to close the loop and complete the business.
* Drive new tape-out management — planning, execution, and operational coordination with headquarters customer service for new product introductions on advanced nodes.
* Promote TSMC's technology roadmap to customers and coordinate internal resources across operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) to meet and exceed customer requirements.
* Resolve production and supply issues across the factory, headquarters, and customer, and grow into account strategy and new-business enablement over time.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, a related engineering/science discipline, or equivalent experience.

With global operations spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, TSMC serves as a committed corporate citizen around the world.

In North America, TSMC has a strong sales and service organization that works with customers by helping them achieve silicon success with cutting-edge technologies and manufacturing excellence. The Company has continued to accelerate its R&D investment and staffing in recent years and is expanding its manufacturing footprint to support customer innovation with 3D IC technologies and optimal manufacturing capacity.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

-------------------

**About Acrisure**

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more.

In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.

**Job Summary:**

Acrisure is seeking a Personal Lines Account Manager to support our growing Client Service Center. This position offers a dynamic opportunity to contribute to client success through strategic consultation, effective relationship management, and the innovative use of technology. This role will manage a book of personal insurance clients, focusing on retention, renewals, and growth through consultative service and cross-selling. You’ll have the opportunity to build strong client relationships, manage policy servicing, and support clients with coverage strategy and solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

Client Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary contact for assigned clients.
* Manage renewals, policy changes, and day-to-day account servicing.
* Provide consultative recommendations and tailored insurance solutions.

Account Growth and Retention

* Identify cross-sell and account rounding opportunities.
* Support retention and client satisfaction goals through proactive engagement.

Collaboration

* Partner with internal teams and leadership to resolve client issues and improve service delivery.
* Promote adoption of digital tools and resources where appropriate.

Client Success

* Deliver high-quality service and support client business needs.
* Complete additional projects or duties as assigned.

*\*This description is not meant to be all-inclusive and may be modified from time to time at the discretion of management\**

**Requirements:**

* Active P&C license
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and systems
* Proficiency with Applied Epic or similar agency management system strongly preferred
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment in collaboration with other team members

**Education and Experience**

* HS Diploma or equivalent (Bachelor's degree preferred)
* 2+ years of experience in personal lines and/or account management experience

#LI-VM1

Pay Details:

The base compensation range for this position is $35 - $35. This range reflects Acrisure's good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Placement within the range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, location, and internal equity.

**Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.**

**Why Join Us:**

At Acrisure, we’re building more than a business, we’re building a community where people can grow, thrive, and make an impact. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future.

Making a lasting impact on the communities it serves, Acrisure has pledged more than $22 million through its partnerships with Corewell Health Helen DeVos Children's Hospital in Grand Rapids, Michigan, UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Blythedale Children's Hospital in Valhalla, New York.

**Employee Benefits**

We also offer our employees a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks, including:

* **Physical Wellness:** Comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; fertility benefits; wellness resources; and paid sick time.
* **Mental Wellness:** Generous paid time off and holidays; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and a complimentary Calm app subscription.
* **Financial Wellness:** Immediate vesting in a 401(k) plan; Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options; commuter benefits; and employee discount programs.
* **Family Care:** Paid maternity leave and paid paternity leave (including for adoptive parents); legal plan options; and pet insurance coverage.
* **… and so much more!**

*This list is not exhaustive of all available benefits. Eligibility and waiting periods may apply to certain offerings. Benefits may vary based on subsidiary entity and geographic location.*

**Acrisure is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Applicants may request reasonable accommodation by contacting *leaves@acrisure.com*.

Final candidates will be required to complete post-offer verification processes related to the role and in accordance with applicable laws.

**California Residents:** Learn more about our privacy practices for applicants by visiting the Acrisure California Applicant Privacy Policy.

**Recruitment Fraud:** Please visit here to learn more about our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

**Welcome, your new opportunity awaits you.**

**About Us**
------------

This role will work with a fast-growing digital media company focused on creating authentic, entertaining, and heartwarming short-form video content. Their portfolio of channels reaches millions of people across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and other social platforms.

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and social-media-savvy **Content Operations & Production Assistant** to support their growing team.

This is a hands-on role that combines social media management, content production, administrative support, and project coordination. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a fast-paced creative environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and takes pride in keeping things running smoothly.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **1. Social Media Publishing & Scheduling**

* Manage daily publishing and scheduling across social media accounts, including Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, Facebook, and YouTube.
* Ensure content is posted accurately and on time across all platforms.
* Prepare and review captions, thumbnails, tags, collaborator invitations, and other publishing details.
* Maintain and update content calendars across four brands.
* Coordinate with editors and team members to ensure content is ready for publication.
* Monitor published posts and troubleshoot any publishing issues.
* Ensure sponsored content is published according to campaign requirements and deadlines.

### **2. Community Management & Engagement**

* Manage daily community engagement across four social media brands.
* Proactively comment on relevant posts from creators, brands, and other accounts to increase visibility and engagement.
* Respond to comments on content in each brand's established voice.
* Identify trending conversations and opportunities for meaningful engagement.
* Monitor audience feedback and flag notable comments, questions, or concerns.
* Help strengthen relationships with online communities through consistent, thoughtful engagement.

### **3. Content Production & Filming**

* Assist with on-the-street filming and interviews throughout New York City.
* Support interviewers and production teams with equipment setup, audio checks, and filming logistics.
* Help identify and approach potential interview subjects when needed.
* Coordinate filming schedules, locations, and production needs.
* Assist with organizing, labeling, and uploading raw footage after shoots.
* Help troubleshoot basic production issues to ensure filming runs smoothly.
* Provide general hands-on support during shoots and special productions.

### **4. Reporting, Analytics & Administrative Support**

* Collect, organize, and maintain social media performance data across all accounts.
* Track key metrics including views, engagement, follower growth, and content performance.
* Prepare regular performance reports and summaries for internal use, brand partners, and sponsors.
* Compile statistics and insights for sponsorship proposals, campaign recaps, and business presentations.
* Maintain accurate spreadsheets, trackers, and reporting documents.
* Assist with general administrative tasks and special projects as needed.

### **5. Communication & Project Coordination**

* Help coordinate communication between internal team members, freelancers, interviewers, editors, and external partners.
* Serve as a point of contact to ensure projects and deliverables move forward efficiently.
* Follow up on outstanding tasks, deadlines, and requests to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Assist with scheduling shoots, meetings, and other production-related activities.
* Track project progress and proactively flag delays or issues.
* Help ensure all parties have the information, assets, and resources needed to complete their work.
* Support day-to-day coordination across multiple brands and business initiatives.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* Strong familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and short-form video content.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Proactive, dependable, and comfortable working independently.

**Preferred**

* Assists with educational activities related to clinical research and digital health for all staff involved.
* Assists with research, policy, and quality projects, integrating system initiatives with a focus on technology-enabled care.
* Provides and assists with expert-level training for research protocols and technology-enabled care model development.
* Supports investigators in crafting research and care model protocols.
* Identifies, completes, and manages research grant applications related to digital health.
* Manages participant activities, including screening, enrollment, and communication across both research and technology platforms.

* Supports statistical needs for clinical research and technology assessments.
* Administers surveys and educational materials in line with study and technology requirements.

* Orients and evaluates cross-functional agile teams, ensuring the focus remains on high-priority tasks and iterative improvement.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The ISV Manager for Sage Intacct is a key commercial role responsible for driving revenue, accelerating partner performance, and expanding adoption of Intacct ISV solutions across North America.
  
  
This role serves as the connective tissue between ISV partners, internal sales teams, VARs, and cross-functional stakeholders. The ISV Manager ensures sellers have clear, accurate, and actionable information—pricing, value propositions, promotions, and sales plays—to operate with speed and confidence.
  
  
The ISV Manager also leads partner-facing commercial initiatives, including campaigns, promotions, and enablement programs, designed to generate pipeline and improve sales execution across regions.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly organized, commercially minded, and thrives in a fast-paced, sales-facing environment while building strong relationships across the Intacct ISV ecosystem.
  
  
\*This is a hybrid role - 3 days onsite\*

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Commercial & Revenue Enablement
  
- Drive sales performance across Intacct price-list ISVs by supporting pipeline creation, monitoring partner activity, and helping regions identify high-value commercial opportunities.
  
- Partner with regional sales leadership to surface trends, whitespace, and growth opportunities across ISVs and customer segments.
  
- Support quota-carrying teams with timely insights that help advance and close ISV-influenced opportunities.
  
  
Sales Enablement & Partner Readiness
  
- Equip sales, VARs, and cross-functional teams with accurate ISV information, pricing guidance, value propositions, and enablement materials that strengthen customer conversations.
  
- Lead the development and maintenance of ISV battlecards, sales plays, and reference materials.
  
- Respond quickly to ad-hoc sales requests, including partner details, pricing checks, commercial insights, and opportunity validation.
  
  
Partner & Program Management
  
- Maintain comprehensive Intacct ISV partner lists and records, ensuring real-time visibility into offerings, promotions, product updates, and go-to-market changes.
  
- Track ISV performance against goals, highlighting trends, risks, and opportunities across partners and regions.
  
- Support partner-facing initiatives such as promotions, campaigns, and limited-time offers in coordination with Marketing and Sales Ops.
  
  
Data, Systems & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
- Ensure data accuracy and consistency in Salesforce to support clean forecasting, reporting, and pipeline visibility.
  
- Collaborate closely with Sales Operations, Finance, Product, and Marketing on KPIs, pricing, commercial positioning, and go-to-market execution.
  
- Identify and recommend improvements to ISV sales processes, tools, and enablement materials to improve seller efficiency and speed to close.
  
  
Skills & Experience:
  
- 3+ years of experience in sales, partner management, channel programs, or sales operations—ideally within accounting software, ERP, or ISV ecosystems.
  
- Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or influencing quota-carrying sales teams.
  
- Proven ability to translate complex product and partner information into clear, compelling sales messaging.
  
- High proficiency in Salesforce, Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
  
- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities across regions and stakeholders.
  
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
- Experience working with ISVs, VARs, or partner ecosystems strongly preferred.
  
  
What Success Looks Like in This Role
  
- Sales teams have clear, current, and trusted ISV information at their fingertips.
  
- ISV pipeline visibility and forecasting accuracy improve.
  
- Partner promotions and sales plays are executed consistently across regions.
  
- Sellers move faster and more confidently when positioning Intacct ISVs with customers.
  
  
Perks? We have plenty.
  
- Competitive salaries that landed us top 5% of similar sized companies (according to Comparably)
  
- Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage
  
- 401(k) retirement match (100% matching up to 4%)
  
- 32 days paid time off (21 personal days, 10 national holidays, 1 floating holiday)
  
- 18 weeks paid parental leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy offered 1 year after start date
  
- 5 days paid yearly to volunteer (through Sage Foundation)
  
- $5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year starting 6 months after hire date
  
- Sage Wellness Rewards Program ($600 wellness credit and $360 fitness reimbursement annually)
  
- Library of on demand career development options and ongoing training offerings

new_jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Mission:** *To effectively coordinate delivery of orders to customers and vendors on time and under budget. Support the operations team by proactively and coherently communicating shipping plans and providing a consistent communication strategy for changes. Redefine and document shipping process within first year.*

**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to join our supply chain operations team. In this pivotal role, you will orchestrate the seamless movement of goods, manage handling/packaging process with suppliers and partners, and optimize transportation planning to ensure timely delivery under budget. Your expertise will drive process improvements, enhance vendor relationships, and support overall supply chain efficiency. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced environment where proactive problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration are key to success.

**Outcomes**

* Project shipment plans are communicated in advance and executed on time; products are delivered by the estimated delivery date
* All consignees are contacted to confirm delivery address and shipment details 2 weeks prior to booking
* Supplier to supplier shipments are managed/coordinated within 12 hours of confirmation
* Schedules are updated and information is communicated as client/vendor dates change within 1 hour of change details
* Shipment plans are executed under budget (+1% project margin)– while maintaining high customer experience (communication, service, accountability performance)
* Accountable for maintaining and following shipping process by end of first year
* Oversee transportation management system to track shipments, optimize freight routes, and monitor delivery schedules.
* Freight claims are initiated within 5 days of delivery AND followed through until resolved.
* Can marshal resources and provide guidance for North American and International shipments when necessary.
* Maintain strong vendor management relationships through effective communication, contract management, and performance evaluations semiannually.
* Initiates proactive solutions to prevent damage to product. Maintains processes for packaging/handling of individual product lines. Existing solutions are re-evaluated annually.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience practicing in a supply chain operations or logistics role with a strong understanding of operations and distribution processes.
* Skilled in data analysis using Excel data analysis tools.
* Familiarity with freight forwarding, 3PL providers, specialty carriers, shipping logistics, and last mile services.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
* Strong communication skills for effective cross-functional collaboration and customer service excellence.Join us as a Logistics Coordinator if you’re passionate about optimizing supply chain processes while working in a vibrant environment that values innovation and teamwork!

Pay: $65,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
